description: Show time increments and rounding rules for company timesheets

id.description: Unique identifier of the rounding configuration.

company_id.description: Identifier of the company this rounding configuration belongs to.

time_increment.description: Time increment in minutes used for rounding timecard entries. Valid values: 1, 5, 6, 10, 15.

rule.description: Rule applied when rounding timecard time values.
